name: v2.7 32 W8: public card values restore with a real fired transition (test cast, no model)

requires.why: seed the test cast first: st-lanes.mts run <n> -- scripts/debug/so-image-cast.mts seed --no-art

steps.eval: const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s=rt.getGlobalSettings(); globalThis.__soV27RollbackPrior={image:s.image.enabled, onDemand:s.sprites.onDemand}; rt.setExtractionSettings({enabled:false}); globalThis.storyOrchestratorImage.updateSettings({enabled:false}); globalThis.storyOrchestratorSprites.updateSettings({onDemand:false}); return {configured:true, prior:globalThis.__soV27RollbackPrior};

steps.slash: /sendas name="SOIMG Wren" raw=false The portrait is ready.

steps.eval: const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.setQuality('done','true'); const s=rt.getSnapshot(); if(s.activeCheckpointId!=='changed'||s.blackboard.hair!=='green')throw Error('entry write missing'); return {checkpoint:s.activeCheckpointId,hair:s.blackboard.hair};

const rt=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const outcome=await rt.rollbackFromMessage(0); if(outcome.result!=='applied')throw Error('rollback must restore a fired boundary'); const s=rt.getSnapshot(); if(s.blackboard.hair!==undefined||s.activeCheckpointId!=='start')throw Error('look did not roll back'); return {restored:true,checkpoint:s.activeCheckpointId};

const p=globalThis.__soV27RollbackPrior; if(!p) return {restored:false, reason:'nothing was switched'}; globalThis.storyOrchestratorImage.updateSettings({enabled:p.image}); globalThis.storyOrchestratorSprites.updateSettings({onDemand:p.onDemand}); const s=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings(); if(s.image.enabled!==p.image||s.sprites.onDemand!==p.onDemand) throw Error('image.enabled / sprites.onDemand did not restore'); delete globalThis.__soV27RollbackPrior; SillyTavern.getContext().saveSettingsDebounced(); return {restored:true, image:s.image.enabled, onDemand:s.sprites.onDemand};
